title: 4th National Pharmacovigilance Week
bodyHtml:
4th National Pharmacovigilance Week


National Coordination Centre - Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission is celebrating 4th National Pharmacovigilance Week from 17-23 September 2024.


Theme "Building ADR Reporting Culture for Patient Safety"
